card.description: Customers at one bakery tasted cookies with different mix-ins and toppings, and said if they liked each one.
card.source: Made for the Sprite Lab 2 app examples.

context.potentialUses: Suggest cookies that customers at this bakery will like.
context.potentialMisuses: It shows what one bakery's customers liked. People in other places may like different cookies.

fields.description: Whether the cookie has chocolate chips: yes or no.
Whether the cookie has raisins: yes or no.
Whether the cookie has frosting on top: yes or no.
Whether the cookie has sprinkles on top: yes or no.
Whether the customer liked the cookie: Like or Dislike.
